newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices up solidly on Monday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices up solidly on Monday.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices rose solidly overnight Monday, spurred by bullish trade houses who wanted to raise chart levels, some brokers said.
NYMEX April crude traded $21.13 a barrel, up 21 cents from the settle as 376 lots traded in the front-month, traders said.
"At twenty points, the move is considered good. It's happend the last two or three (ACCESS) sessions," a broker said. Total volume stood at 800 lots.

NYMEX heating oil traded at 54.40 cents a gallon, up 0.10 cents from the settle amid volume of 43 lots in April and 62 in all months. Gasoline was bought at 65.30 cents, up 0.44 cents as 60 lots changed hands in April, traders said.
